row.evidence: Stamped's user-management guide says new users are added with the "Invite User" button and log in with an email and password, and its help centre returns "No results" for scim, sso and okta.
row.notes: New row. None by absence (medium): no SCIM, SAML/OIDC SSO or IdP integration is documented anywhere in the help centre or developer docs; users are invited by email (Store Owner, Store Admin, Member roles) and removed manually. The pricing page (stamped.io/pricing -> website.stamped.io) returned 403 to every fetch, so plan prices are not recorded; the billing guide says there are three monthly plans (Reviews, Loyalty, Full Suite) and the free Starter tier was removed. The public API manages shopper customers, products and orders, not dashboard users.

scim.notes: False by absence: help-centre search returns no results for scim, sso or okta; the developer docs cover shopper, product and order records only.

auth.notes: Public key / private key pair from Settings > Review Integrations > API Keys.

user_api.notes: False by absence for dashboard users: the public API's Merchant, Loyalty and Reviews endpoints manage the store's shopper customers, products and orders, not Stamped dashboard users. API keys can be generated only by the Account Owner.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/stamped/ and /stamped-io/ return 404; help-centre search for okta returns no results.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (stamped-tutorial, stamped-io-tutorial return 404).

fallbacks.notes: Users must be invited and set a password, or sign in through Shopify with an existing Stamped user; there is no SSO, so no JIT.
